description:
We are Team CIVILIAN, a group of passionate and innovative engineering students. We believe in teamwork, creativity, and thinking beyond boundaries. We aim to use science, technology, and NASA data to solve real-world problems. Our team combines different ideas, skills, and perspectives to create meaningful solutions. We are excited to explore new challenges and turn our ideas into reality.

Our motto is simple: "Cup namdhe, kathe nimdhe...!!!" 🏆
